skill.displayName: Free AI Photo Collage Maker – Create Instagram Collages Online with AI – API-powered
skill.summary: AI collage maker — create a chaotic multi-media collage from up to 10 images

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Collage Maker skill.
- Create a chaotic, multi-media collage from up to 10 images.
- Supports custom style instructions and batch generation.
- Requires HTTPS access and a WeShop API key.
- Includes endpoints for starting collage runs, polling status, and uploading images.
